title: Testing concept-level audits of melanoma classifiers with diffusion counterfactuals and matched positive controls
abstract: arXiv:2611.02119v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Concept-based explanations of melanoma classifiers are rarely tested against controls with known targets. We built a counterfactual audit from a diffusion model conditioned on seven 7-point checklist concepts and tested it with such controls. Colour-calibrated start noise reduced colour outliers from 78.5-84.8\% to 6.6-13.3\%. Four of seven knobs were target-dominant but also changed other concepts. Quartile-based positive controls were confounded, and the audit failed its pre-specified rule. It recovered the targets of all 16 controls matched on the generator's pseudo-labels and of 12 of 12 controls labelled by a second evaluator, for three concepts; concept activation vectors recovered fewer (11 of 16). In 18 permuted-label classifiers, significant sweep responses and target rankings also arose, whereas standardised effect margins separated the controls from these null classifiers. translated_title: 使用扩散反事实样本和匹配阳性对照测试黑色素瘤分类器的概念级审计
translated_abstract: 基于概念的黑色素瘤分类器解释很少针对具有已知目标的对照进行测试。我们基于以七点检查表中七个概念为条件的扩散模型构建了一个反事实审计，并使用此类对照对其进行了测试。经过色彩校准的起始噪声将颜色异常值从78.5-84.8%降低到6.6-13.3%。七个控制旋钮中有四个是目标主导的，但也会改变其他概念。基于四分位数的阳性对照存在混杂因素，该审计未能通过预先设定的规则。对于三个概念，它成功恢复了所有16个按生成器伪标签匹配的对照的目标，以及由第二位评估者标注的12个对照中全部12个的目标；而概念激活向量恢复的数量较少（16个中恢复了11个）。在18个置换标签分类器中，也出现了显著的扫描响应和目标排名，而标准化的效应边际成功地将对照与这些零分类器区分开来。色素沉着的扫描提高了黑色素瘤的……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究构建了基于扩散模型的条件反事实审计框架，并通过匹配的阳性对照严格验证了其对黑色素瘤分类器概念级解释的审计能力，证明该方法在恢复目标概念方面优于传统的概念激活向量方法。
en_tdlr: This study develops a diffusion-model-based counterfactual audit with matched positive controls to rigorously test concept-level explanations of melanoma classifiers, demonstrating superior concept recovery over concept activation vectors.
